E.name: Tectonic Disruption
E.title: Template:Data Vel'Koz/Tectonic Disruption
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Tectonic Disruption|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vel'Koz
|skill        = E
|icon         = Tectonic Disruption.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} hurls a disruptive anomaly at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stuns}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' hurls a disruptive anomaly that lands to the target location after {{pp|0.25;0.25 to 0.55|0;150 to 800 by 50|type=cast distance|formula=0.25 until 150 cast distance; 0.25 + 0.3 * (cast distance - 150) / 650 until maximum cast distance}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area briefly.
|description2 = If ''Tectonic Disruption'' is cast in close proximity of '''Vel'Koz''', the anomaly will also slightly {{tip|airborne|knock back}} enemies hit in the direction of the cast.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 10}}
|target range = 800<!--
|missile cast range?= 1100-->
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 225
|speed        = 
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe 
|projectile   = Special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The required proximity for the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} is relative to '''Vel'Koz's''' position when casting and not his current one.
* While the effect is fully prevented by blocking the missile (e.g. with {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} and {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}), the missile may not be destroyed ''visually''.{{bug}}
* The area of effect indicator appears at the end of the cast time.
** It will persist even if the cast cancels (e.g. '''Vel'Koz''' dies before cast time completes) despite the projectile not firing.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
{{effect at cast time start}}
}}

R.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
R.title: Template:Data Vel'Koz/Life Form Disintegration Ray
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Life Form Disintegration Ray|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Vel'Koz |skill = R |icon = Researched.png |blurbicon = Life Form Disintegration Ray.png |blurb = {{sbc|Passive - Researched:}} Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks will mark the target ''Researched'' for a few seconds, which refreshes on basic attacks and ability hits. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vel'Koz}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time to project an energy beam that continually deals {{as|magic damage}}, applies ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'', and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit. During this time, '''Vel'Koz''' can steer the beam in the target direction.
''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vel'Koz''' ends ''Life Form Disintegration Ray''. |blurb4 = {{sbc|{{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz}} Bonus:}} The beam deals {{as|true damage}} instead. |description = {{sbc|Passive - Researched:}} Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks to an enemy {{tip|champion}} marks them as ''Researched'' for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them. |icon2 = Life Form Disintegration Ray.png |description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.2}}-second delay, '''Vel'Koz''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.6}} seconds to project an energy beam, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. ''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast after 1 second during the channel, and does so automatically after the duration. |description3 = The beam deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit every {{fd|0.2}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20%, lingering for 1 second. ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'' is applied every {{fd|0.7}} seconds to enemies hit. {{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz|''Researched''}} enemies take {{as|true damage}} instead. |leveling3 = {{st|Damage Per Tick|{{ap|(450*0.2)/2.6|(700*0.2)/2.6|(925*0.2)/2.6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|125*0.2/2.6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Maximum Damage|{{ap|450|700|925}} {{as|(+ 125% AP)}}}} |description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vel'Koz''' ends ''Life Form Disintegration Ray''. |cost = 100 |costtype = Mana |cooldown = {{ap|100 to 80}} |cdstart = post-effect |cast time = none |range = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1555|Measured}} |width = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 175 |targeting = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]] |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic True |spellshield = |spelleffects = aoedot |projectile = False |silence = true |notes = * ''Life Form Disintegration Ray's'' direction updates gradually (moving the cursor from one side of '''Vel'Koz''' to the other will not make him rotate instantly). * '''Vel'Koz''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} himself if the ray is near an enemy champion. * The beam hits in a rectangular shape, intersecting with the edge of an enemy {{tip|gameplay radius}}. ** Because of this, the effect will hit enemies whose center location is to the sides and/or slightly behind Vel'Koz, as long as their radius intersects with the area. * The following table refers for interactions while '''Vel'Koz''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}: {{ct|channel|attack=false|cast=false|move=false|items=interrupts,true,,false|spells=true, false, interrupts, interrupts, false}} }}
